summary: Part 1 (00:00-07:54) of the 3.0 Buybox (KAMs) video. The trainer (Pierre) walks through the Buybox tab of the 'Smart Cell x Revibe' Google Sheet: the Revibe-controlled catalogue and filters, Monthly Sales bands, the Neutral Buybox AE/SA columns (from frame t00194), the seller Score, the Price AE formula =N3*(1+P3), Buybox AE/SA and Wins AE/SA, and the red (AE) vs green (SA) shipping split. He then opens the Reporting bookmark, the Revibe Workspace and the Seller Performance page for Smart Cell (Score +2.7%), and shows the Buybox AI workbook (database score AE and database score SA tabs) for SKU 980105-000004. All 40 frames cited in pack-1 were opened, and the frames were checked against the cited transcript lines. Several frame citations pointed at the wrong frame and were corrected. Gaps remain: the Min AE/Min SA columns, 'No bid', '134 - Fulfillment', the Scored Price columns, the ranking rule and the currency glyph are not explained in this part.
